positions = jnp.array([[-0.60, 0.0, 0.0], [0.60, 0.0, 0.0]])
energy_fn = partial(
    harmonic_pair_energy,
    spring_constant=2.0,
    equilibrium_distance=1.0,
)
energy = energy_fn(positions)
forces = forces_from_energy(energy_fn, positions)

print(f"positions shape: {positions.shape}")
print(f"potential energy: {float(energy):.4f}")
print("forces on atoms:")
print(forces)
print(f"net force: {jnp.sum(forces, axis=0)}")
